title: A group's forge adapter, named as extension point forge, answers every merge request and pipeline read that land, stalled and red-pipeline make
goal: bl_forge.arm(root) returns the adapter of extensions.forge when the settings layers name one (a class built as Adapter(target, run, cwd) with the methods request, pipelines, pipeline, jobs, trace, set_description and merge that the shipped glab and gh arms have), else the glab or gh arm the forge setting picks as now; extending.md lists those methods and their return shapes as the forge point's contract, and land, stalled and red-pipeline reach the forge only through arm.

run:
import json,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); subprocess.run(["git","init","-q",str(d)],check=True); e=d/"ext"; e.mkdir()
(d/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items","forge":"gitlab","forge_project":"corp/kb"}),encoding="utf-8")
(e/"grp_forge.py").write_text("KBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=1.0,<2\"\nclass Adapter:\n    def __init__(self, target, run, cwd=None):\n        self.target = target\n    def request(self, branch=None, title_prefix=None):\n        return {\"state\": \"merged\", \"branch\": branch}\n",encoding="utf-8")
(d/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"extensions":{"forge":"grp_forge:Adapter"},"extension_paths":["ext"]}),encoding="utf-8")
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bl_base,bl_forge
bl_base.load_settings(str(d)); a=bl_forge.arm(str(d))
assert type(a).__module__=="grp_forge", type(a)
assert a.request(branch="code/ST-aaaaaaaa")["state"]=="merged"
